lines: Thus many varieties this, venerable Khecarī alone is sung; others her limb-born but, Padmā and the rest, in Mālinī doctrine.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ityevaṃbahubhedeyaṃ śrīkhecaryeva gīyate anyāstadaṅgabhūtāstu padmādyā mālinīmate
